segments.narration: Own physical silver tax-advantaged retirement growth now. A self-directed IRA lets you hold physical silver inside a tax-advantaged retirement account.
IRAs held $19.2 trillion in assets at year-end 2025, representing 39 percent of all U.S.
A custodian charging 0.5 percent on a $100,000 account costs $500 per year.
A flat-fee custodian charges the same $150 to $250 regardless of account size.
The 2026 IRS contribution limit is $7,000 per year, or $8,000 if you are 50 or older.
